summary: Players will enjoy it: six shows everyone knows (The Simpsons, both Law & Orders, Family Guy, NCIS, Grey's Anatomy) come fast, and Gunsmoke and Lassie make a good reveal. The sting is that Friends, The Office and The Big Bang Theory each cost a life, so most games end at 7 or 8 found with no lives left.
reasons: Casual found 8 (the six gimmes, Criminal Minds, American Dad!) and lost lives on Friends (10 seasons), Supernatural (15), The Office (9), The Big Bang Theory (12) and Bob's Burgers (16); a second casual run found 7. The fan got 10/10, losing lives on ER and Supernatural.

Seasons reads clearly and every miss shows its count. Famous long shows that don't qualify are all free: South Park, SNL, SpongeBob, It's Always Sunny, Days of Our Lives, General Hospital, Survivor, Jeopardy, Doctor Who.

Wrinkle: the counts are total seasons wherever they aired, so American Dad! (TBS 2014-2025), Criminal Minds (4 seasons on Paramount+) and Lassie (2 in syndication) make the top 10 although the prompt says 'on US broadcast networks'. Someone who lost a life on Bob's Burgers (16, all on Fox) could object to Criminal Minds (15 on CBS) at #10.
fixes: Prompt: say how seasons count, e.g. 'Name the 10 scripted primetime series that began on a US broadcast network (ABC, CBS, NBC, Fox, The CW) with the most seasons, wherever later seasons aired'. Reword rather than recount: broadcast-only counts would leave #10 a six-way tie at 15 seasons.

Lassie fact is off: the source says the FCC's Prime Time Access Rule took its 7 p.m. Sunday slot and the NFL games were a further reason, not that the games pushed it out of 7 p.m. Better: it ran 17 seasons on CBS, then its last two in syndication. American Dad!'s fact could say it spent 2014-2025 on TBS before returning to Fox, which explains its 22.

Spin-offs not on the list get 'did you mean' to the parent: Law & Order: Criminal Intent, Organized Crime, Trial by Jury, LA, True Crime, Toronto (to #3 Law & Order); NCIS: Hawai'i, Origins, Sydney, Tony & Ziva (to #5 NCIS); Criminal Minds: Suspect Behavior, Beyond Borders (to #10). Add them to knownNames so they are free. Keep Criminal Minds: Evolution going to Criminal Minds, since its seasons count.

'ncis la' gets 'did you mean NCIS' (#5) instead of #18 NCIS: Los Angeles: add 'NCIS LA' / 'NCIS: LA' to NCIS: Los Angeles. Add 'L&O' to #3 Law & Order and 'L&O SVU' to #2. For Blitz, these short forms aren't recognized: 'Parks and Rec' (Parks and Recreation), 'Brooklyn 99' (Brooklyn Nine-Nine), 'HIMYM' (How I Met Your Mother), 'TBBT' (The Big Bang Theory).
